claimDeviation.whatWasNotDone: The claim ledger was not edited. No grant was minted, no lane vocabulary was widened, and nothing was written outside this lane's own directory. The ledger still verifies unchanged.
claimDeviation.whatCaptainMustStillDo: Mint independent-verification grants for these four families and dispatch the lane under a name the kind regex resolves, so the record shows a claimed lane rather than an assigned one. Until then these rows are evidence without a ledger entry behind them.

builderStatedReason.finding: The official form for this family is CC-1203, and the PF01 assignment table named CC-1201.
builderStatedReason.consequence: PF01 assigned CC-1201. CC-1201's Section C accepts an ancillary matter only as an addition to a charge or conviction listed on its page 1, so an ancillary-matter-only petition cannot be expressed on it at all; CC-1203 Section B is exactly this route and asks for the already-sealed offence rather than a charge to seal. The track's recorded authority in data/rcap-ledger/track-pathway-crosswalk.json is § 19.2-392.12:1(B) and (J). The family is built on CC-1203 and this discrepancy is the lane's principal finding.
